title: Deeper/broader consumer-ledger and cross-peer security reconciliation
mode: read-only primary-source research and focused local source inspection
scope: Reconcile LibreCAD 3's published DWG claim policy with the existing consumer-compatibility and support boundaries
Cross-map current LibreDWG security disclosures to local DWG parser/writer guard points and existing hardening owners
Check whether GDAL's public DXF known-issues page is current enough or complete enough to act as a comparator contract
Refine the implementation plan without expanding the local fast-slice queue or changing support claims

method.kind: Read-only review of public primary-source project documentation/release notes and focused local source inspection
method.limitations: GitHub master pages are mutable. The LibreCAD 3 claim/status JSON files were not fetched directly in this pass; counts, blockers, and freeze state are taken from its published DWG policy page. Static local inspection is not an execution of peer security reproducers or a complete audit of all object-table growth paths.

sources.revision: mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-17; exact commit not captured
sources.observed: The project documents opt-in DWG reading through WITH_DWG_IMPORT and no DWG writing. Its linked claim ledger is described as frozen with 15 read-direction claims: 11 EXPERIMENTAL, four PENDING_NATIVE, none PROMOTED. Experimental claims retain reviewed-target-debt and unresolved-integrity-diagnostic blockers. The page sets separate prerequisites for any future DWG-write policy. This is consumer policy, not independent parser evidence.

sources.revision: mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-17; exact commit not captured
sources.observed: The README reports a narrow FreeCAD 1.1.3/macOS arm64 DWG-converter-to-C++-DXF-importer profile and explicitly leaves native Linux and Windows profiles unqualified. The report is not a new independent run; the local detailed qualification record remains scoped to its exact tools, inputs, importer mode, and assertions.

The notes list concrete R2004 decompression/page-map sizing and bounds fixes, R2007 page-range checks, a 3DSOLID SAT block-size overflow, non-finite MLINESTYLE angle loop, stale object pointers across reallocating object operations, pre-R13 OOM/no-progress handling, and HATCH/binary-DXF corrections. These disclose peer failure modes but do not establish matching local defects or peer semantic completeness.

sources.revision: mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-17; document identifies itself as a 2018 snapshot
sources.observed: The page lists unsupported DXF entities and projection/round-trip limitations, including missing 3D/OCS in selected projected entities and dropped block attributes on write. Its age and OGR projection model prevent treating it as a current complete DXF parser/writer contract.

pathsInspected: src/intern/dwgutil.cpp: dwgCompressor::decompress18 input-window and back-reference guards
src/intern/dwgreader18.cpp: dwgReader18::parseDataPage checked page geometry, ranges, and bounded allocation
src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseDwg positive/capped SAT block framing
src/drw_objects.cpp: DRW_MLineStyle DWG writer finite-angle admission
localSourceCrossCheck.assessment: The focused source view found corresponding guard points for the reviewed decompression/page, SAT-length, and finite-angle failure classes. It did not establish that every upstream reproducer is covered, inspect every reallocating object-table path, or execute any malformed input. No local defect was confirmed.

implementationDisposition.nextSlice: The 7G.3d placement-prefix sub-slice is complete; continue with the next dependency-ready item already present in the implementation plan. Do not add per-slice peer/runtime/full-suite work.
implementationDisposition.consumerBoundary: Keep LibreCAD source-compatibility checks distinct from LibreCAD 3's read-only, frozen DWG claim ledger. Keep 2D default projection independent from opt-in typed 3D delivery.
implementationDisposition.securityBoundary: Use peer disclosures as focused test-shape leads. When touching a corresponding local owner, use a generated boundary/malformed case and a following-record/object sentinel; broader fuzz/sanitizer checks remain at the scheduled checkpoint.
implementationDisposition.gdalBoundary: Use only a pinned GDAL version/profile for named projection comparisons; do not turn the 2018 known-issues list into a current local finding or full semantic oracle.
